acquisition.details: Implemented `eyes install pi` and `src/pi_install.rs`. The installer writes a project-local `.pi/extensions/extra-eyes.ts` extension, records pi input and session_shutdown events through `eyes feed`, fetches pending hook-channel watcher messages through `eyes hook fetch`, prepends fetched feedback to user input, and skips extension-originated input to avoid feedback loops. README now documents the pi install path. Verification: cargo fmt --check; cargo test; cargo install --path . --locked --root /private/tmp/extra-eyes-install-check --force; installed-binary smoke ran `eyes install pi --project /private/tmp/extra-eyes-pi-install-check/project --eyes-bin /private/tmp/extra-eyes-install-check/bin/eyes --json` and confirmed the generated extension contains input, session_shutdown, hook fetch, and extension-source guard wiring.
